annotations.title: Wire voltage drop and conductor sizing

description: Wire voltage drop and conductor sizing — Electrical voltage drop calculator and wire-size picker. amps + one-way length_ft (or length_m); optional volts (default 120), phase=1|3, material=copper|aluminum, awg=12 (or 1/0, 250 kcmil) to check a size, max_pct (default 3), continuous=true (125% ampacity). Returns drop volts/percent, voltage at load, 75C ampacity, verdict, recommended smallest AWG meeting both ampacity and drop, nearby sizes and max run length. Uses NEC Chapter 9 Table 8 style DC resistance; estimate only. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_voltage_drop
